summary: Customer runs a cell culture process in an aqueous medium and measures glucose and lactate from samples, but the delay makes it difficult to see changes promptly. They are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot checked against existing laboratory measurements. The medium and cell population change during the run; no probe or calibration strategy has been selected.
